summary: A Quote subscription streams Vortex ohlcv: the 62-byte packet gives the price, trade time, OHLC and volume, and no last quantity, average price or book totals; a packet with no trade time is stamped on receipt.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change, change_percent); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent on an instrument beside the web adapter's own change keys (change, change_percent); the adapter sends no price_change, which is not a docs key, so it goes. Open until wire's per-broker rule for canonical keys (each key's mode range or never, index and non-index apart; lead 2026-11-09).

The web sends null; the docs say leave it out (lead decision 2026-11-09, 4(c)): an ltp packet, or an ohlcv packet before the first trade, carries no trade time, so the desktop's frame has no ltt, where the web sends ltt null.
Without a trade time or update time the web sends timestamp null, a market data frame with no time (the SDK reads data.timestamp); the desktop stamps the time the packet was received.
